extracted.intended_audience: researchers in numerical analysis, optimal transport, and computational/machine-learning scientists interested in particle-based simulations
extracted.subtask_description: Developing and evaluating an Euler-type, measure-valued forecasting method that uses linearized optimal transport to predict the time evolution of probability measures arising from stochastic particle systems. The work targets algorithm design, theoretical error analysis, and empirical validation on agent-based, PDE, and Langevin dynamics examples.
